Not sure what to say about this beyond the title. Our last element caught fire (that was quite exciting watching metal - or whatever the coating is on these things - turn bright red and disintegrate). We actually had intended to use this as an excuse to get a new oven. But we couldn't find one with the features we wanted in the price range we were willing to spend (why's it so hard to find a knob to turn on the oven? I hate digital ovens).

Took probably five minutes to replace the element. If you know how to use a screwdriver, you can do this (only 2 screws and a couple slide on electrical connections). However, a big WARNING to anybody that is thinking of doing this. Make sure you unplug your oven before you take out the old element. There are 220 volts going to this thing. You do not want to know what that feels like (not personal experience, thankfully - 110 volts is enough for me).
Easy to identify the correct heating element, low cost, fast delivery. The only bad news is that the fastening screws holding the original element proved too difficult to remove.

Title says "by Whirlpool", it is not by Whirlpool.
Says "Genuine Replacement Part, Whirlpool item" it is not a genuine Whirlpool part, it is a knock-off part. Arrived and does not have FSP logo or any part numbers on the part. All Whirlpool genuine parts carry the FSP logo and have part numbers on them.
DO NOT BUY, if you want a knockoff part, they are available for 1/2 this price. Genuine part is $10 more.

Works in a 1980s-model Jenn-Air small wall oven model w2720B, for which whirlpool no longer makes the correct, original part. This is less expensive than having a new oven installed, and it gets the job done. In my experience, I’ve had to junk nearly as many modern appliances as I have had to buy because manufacturers’ standards have dropped in the past twenty years, and the big box places mainly deal in garbage meant to last two years tops.

If you have something older, and it does the job, keep it. They’re usually easy to repair, and Amazon is making it even easier by offering products like this.
